payload.title: File:Aeolosaurus forelimb.jpg
payload.artist_html: Rodolfo A. Garcia and Leonardo Salgado
payload.description_html:
Titanosaur sauropod Aeolosaurus sp., forelimb from Salitral Moreno locality, Rio Negro, Argentina, Campanian–Maastrichtian, Upper Cretaceous. A. Left humerus (MPCA−Pv 27176), in anterior (A1), posterior (A2), proximal (A3), and distal (A4) views. B. Metacarpal III (MPCA−Pv 27174), in anterior view. C. Right ulna (MPCA−Pv 27174), in lateral (C1), posterior (C2), proximal (C3), and distal (C4) views. D. Left ulna (MPCA−Pv 27180), in lateral view.

E. Left radius (MPCA−Pv 27174), in posterior view.
